cases.injection: A ready manifest-verified result exists for the complete pre-reservation identity.
cases.retry_rule: No retry or attachment; return the immutable result.
cases.ownership_result: No reservation, worker attachment, sandbox, session, execution, publication, or cleanup ownership exists.

cases.injection: Cached provider capabilities cannot satisfy the planned profile.
cases.retry_rule: Retry only after a new capability snapshot advertises the exact planned profile; never rewrite it.
cases.ownership_result: No worker or sandbox ownership; release any queued reservation identity idempotently.

cases.injection: The provider returns unavailable before a worker exists.
cases.retry_rule: A policy-controlled later retry may issue a new reservation after provider recovery.
cases.ownership_result: No fabricated worker or artifact; any reservation request is closed.

cases.injection: The acquired worker attests a digest different from the planned profile.
cases.retry_rule: A new attempt may use a distinct compatible worker; the planned profile and cache identity remain unchanged.
cases.ownership_result: Quarantine or refresh the mismatched worker and release the exact reservation.

cases.injection: A manifest references a blob unavailable at controller and worker CAS.
cases.retry_rule: Retry only after an authorized source republishes the same expected digest.
cases.ownership_result: Destroy the partial attempt sandbox and release its reservation/session.

cases.injection: Transferred chunk bytes do not match the declared chunk digest.
cases.retry_rule: A bounded re-fetch starts at the rejected chunk offset; unchanged corrupt bytes do not loop.
cases.ownership_result: Delete only the rejected temporary chunk and eventually clean the attempt sandbox.

cases.injection: All chunks arrive but the reconstructed object digest differs from the manifest.
cases.retry_rule: Discard the reconstructed temporary object and re-fetch from a verified source.
cases.ownership_result: No corrupt CAS object becomes visible; clean the attempt sandbox.

cases.injection: Transfer disconnects after a prefix of chunks.
cases.retry_rule: Resume only from the last verified chunk identity and verify the complete final object before use.
cases.ownership_result: The same live attempt retains temporary verified chunks until reconnect deadline, then cleans or records an orphan.

cases.injection: The received manifest digest differs from the producer-recorded manifest identity.
cases.retry_rule: Do not retry against the same tampered manifest; require the original producer identity.
cases.ownership_result: Build remains durably successful; downstream attempt cleans without using bytes.

cases.injection: Transport drops after sending Exec but before the acknowledgement is observed.
cases.retry_rule: Reconnect and query the same operation ID; duplicate delivery returns the persisted prior result.
cases.ownership_result: One execution identity owns at most one process tree.

cases.injection: Transport drops after a durable log chunk but before later chunks are consumed.
cases.retry_rule: Replay after the last acknowledged cursor with stable sequence and byte digests.
cases.ownership_result: Execution continues under the same attempt until its lease or reconnect deadline expires.

cases.injection: Transport drops after atomic publication may have committed but before acknowledgement.
cases.retry_rule: Query by operation and result identity; repeat the compare-and-swap idempotently only when absence is proven.
cases.ownership_result: At most one verified manifest is visible for the logical result.

cases.injection: Transport drops after cleanup starts and before release acknowledgement.
cases.retry_rule: Reconnect and query exact ownership; repeat cleanup idempotently or record an exact orphan at deadline.
cases.ownership_result: Each exact resource is released once or represented by one durable orphan record.

cases.injection: An acquired worker disappears permanently while the process is active.
cases.retry_rule: A retry uses a distinct compatible worker, rematerializes and reverifies immutable inputs, and supersedes only the lost attempt.
cases.ownership_result: Lost resources become exact queryable orphans until provider reconciliation confirms release.

cases.injection: Cancellation arrives before any worker is acquired.
cases.retry_rule: No automatic retry; a later resume is a new attempt under persisted plan compatibility.
cases.ownership_result: Close any queued reservation; create no worker, sandbox, or session ownership.

cases.injection: Cancellation arrives while the command process tree is active.
cases.retry_rule: No automatic retry; preserve already successful upstream artifacts.
cases.ownership_result: Stop exact descendants and release or orphan exact reservation, sandbox, and session within the bound.

cases.injection: The worker remains healthy and the command returns a non-zero status.
cases.retry_rule: Apply only declared command retry policy; do not classify as infrastructure loss.
cases.ownership_result: Worker remains reusable after sandbox cleanup if health and attestation remain valid.

cases.injection: A prior operation is duplicated or delivered with a stale expected revision.
cases.retry_rule: Identical identity plus payload digest replays the result; conflicting payload or revision fails closed.
cases.ownership_result: No duplicated reservation, process, publication, release, or cleanup target.

cases.injection: A superseded attempt token requests attachment or log replay.
cases.retry_rule: No retry with the stale token; query durable node status using authorized controller identity.
cases.ownership_result: Current attempt ownership is unchanged.

cases.injection: A declared output is missing or resolves outside the attempt sandbox.
cases.retry_rule: No publication retry without a fresh successful command attempt.
cases.ownership_result: No result identity becomes visible; clean attempt-owned files only.

cases.injection: Collected bytes or symlink/path metadata do not match the output manifest.
cases.retry_rule: Discard the candidate output and require a fresh execution attempt.
cases.ownership_result: No corrupt result or partial manifest becomes visible.

cases.injection: The manifest/object write fails or another attempt wins compare-and-swap.
cases.retry_rule: Reconcile by result identity; accept an existing result only after full verification and semantic identity match.
cases.ownership_result: Temporary publication state is removed or recorded as an exact orphan.

cases.injection: One experiment-owned resource does not release before the 30-second deadline.
cases.retry_rule: The reaper queries and retries only the exact orphan identity under its cleanup allowlist.
cases.ownership_result: Logical success remains success with cleanup warning; failed/cancelled outcomes remain unchanged and the orphan is durable.

cases.injection: The controlling client disappears and the namespace lease expires.
cases.retry_rule: A reaper continues cancellation-detached cleanup; no new caller inherits mutable state.
cases.ownership_result: Every reservation, sandbox, session, execution, and temporary publication is released or recorded exactly.

cases.injection: Durable state contains one live, one already-released, and one unknown provider resource identity.
cases.retry_rule: Retry exact live orphan cleanup; preserve unknown identities for manual review without widening scope.
cases.ownership_result: The confirmed orphan is released once; already-released stays idempotent; unknown remains recorded.

cases.injection: The downstream W2 test worker is lost after the upstream build artifact is durably published.
cases.retry_rule: Resume only the affected node on a distinct compatible worker from the persisted plan and original verified manifest.
cases.ownership_result: Exactly one upstream build completion/publication and one final downstream logical result remain visible.
